China's August LNG Imports Projected to Decline Amid High Prices

China's liquefied natural gas (LNG) imports are projected to decrease in August compared to the previous year. Data from ship-tracking indicates that elevated prices, influenced by the conflict in the Middle East, are impacting consumption. This trend suggests a slowdown in demand for LNG in China due to cost factors.
